name: Leader Harmonious Drive Systems

summary: Leader Harmonious Drive Systems, trading as Leaderdrive, develops and manufactures strain-wave reducers and rotary actuators for robotics and precision automation. Its catalog includes compact, hollow-shaft and flat harmonic-drive families, alongside integrated rotary actuators.
